summary: Performance Management for Nonprofit Employees is the systematic process of aligning individual staff contributions with the organization's mission.
lede: Performance Management for Nonprofit Employees helps you connect individual goals with mission objectives through structured methods for goal setting, feedback, development, and outcome measurement. You will learn to craft mission-aligned KPIs, apply OKRs, conduct 360-degree feedback, and use engagement surveys to support stronger performance and retention. The course also covers nonprofit applications of the Balanced Scorecard and Kirkpatrick Model, succession planning with RACI matrices, digital dashboards, and AI-assisted performance analytics. Through practical nonprofit scenarios, you will build a cohesive approach to monitoring impact, developing talent, allocating resources, and producing reports for boards and donors.
audienceIntro: This course targets professionals in the nonprofit sector who handle or influence employee performance and development.
prerequisites: No formal prerequisites, but participants should have at least 2 years of experience in a nonprofit role and familiarity with basic HR practices. Bring examples of current performance challenges from your organization for workshop discussions.
